name: std::messages_byname

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

class messages_byname : public std::messages<CharT>;

intro: std::messages_byname is a std::messages facet which encapsulates retrieval of strings from message catalogs of the locale specified at its construction.

 (since C++11) 



Constructs a new std::messages_byname facet for a locale with name. 
refs is used for resource management: if refs == 0, the implementation destroys the facet, when the last std::locale object holding it is destroyed. Otherwise, the object is not destroyed.

 Parameters




 name

 -

 the name of the locale


 refs

 -

 the number of references that link to the facet
